summary.en: Run graphical programs (a terminal, an editor, any GUI app) on its own hidden 1920x1080 screen, drive them with a real pointer and keyboard, and look at the result through the Vision model. Never touches your desktop.
summary.ru: Запускает графические программы (терминал, редактор, любое GUI-приложение) на собственном скрытом экране 1920x1080, управляет ими настоящими указателем и клавиатурой и смотрит на результат через Vision-модель. Ваш рабочий стол не затрагивается.

required.name: display
required.reason: the programs run on their own virtual screen, never on yours

required.name: permissions.request
required.reason: to ask you before describing the screen with the Vision model

optional.name: images.analyze
optional.reason: to describe a screenshot with the Vision model

tools.name: launch
tools.summary: Start a program on the screen. The project's permission rules decide whether it may start; otherwise the person (or auto mode's classifier) is asked, and an 'always allow' answer is saved in permissions.json. Returns the new windows. A terminal or other OpenGL program needs gl=true.

gl.description: Enable OpenGL (software). Needs the screen restarted if programs already run; costs about 26 MiB more.

reason.description: Why, in the person's language; shown when asking.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.summary: Save a screenshot of the whole screen with the real pointer drawn on it. With question, the Vision model describes it: you do not see the picture yourself, so ask about the thing you need.

tools.name: mouse
tools.summary: Move the real pointer along a natural curved path to the exact point, then act. Actions: move, click, double_click, press, release, drag (needs to_x, to_y), scroll (dx, dy in steps; dy>0 down). Omit x and y to act where the pointer is.

tools.name: keyboard
tools.summary: Type text (any Unicode) and/or press a key combination such as ctrl+shift+v, Return, alt+F4. paste=true puts the text on the clipboard and presses paste_keys (default ctrl+v; terminals use ctrl+shift+v) for text key presses cannot carry.

tools.name: windows
tools.summary: List the windows (id, title, class, position, size, minimized) or act on one: focus, move (x, y), resize (width, height), minimize, close.

tools.name: apps
tools.summary: List the programs started here, or stop them all (stop_all).

tools.name: status
tools.summary: Memory of the screen itself (server, window manager, this skill's process) in MiB of proportional set size, against its 40 MiB budget. Programs you started are not counted.
